title: Structured logging baseline with tracing

user_story.i_want: structured logs with consistent fields from every service
user_story.so_that: I can follow one file through the whole pipeline

description: Add a shared `init_tracing()` in stratum-core using tracing-subscriber with EnvFilter (RUST_LOG). It uses pretty output locally and JSON when `STRATUM_LOG_FORMAT=json`. Convention: spans carry `file_id` / `event_id` where relevant; prefer `#[instrument]` on important functions.

acceptance_criteria.then: debug logs appear; the default level is info
each line is one JSON object with timestamp, level, target, fields and span fields
its log lines include the span and the non-skipped arguments
each calls the shared init exactly once
